decision.summary: The supplied CPU accounting mean is 0.96 (96%) over a stated 72-hour window, with an accounting decision of WITHIN_TOLERANCE. Zero pressure and zero CFS throttling each describe only 300 observed seconds (five minutes), approximately 0.11574% of that window. Those quiet observations do not clear our own workload as a possible cause; 71 hours and 55 minutes per channel remain unobserved. No service-impact evidence is supplied, so the accounting result does not establish application health or provider responsibility.
decision.next_action: Keep workload attribution unresolved. The next useful evidence would be already-retained pressure, throttling, execution/demand and service-impact observations aligned to the same assessment window, with sufficient per-channel coverage and freshness. The supplied fixture cannot provide that evidence. Do no new measurement or external action under the current request.

semantic_review.finding: Correctly preserves WITHIN_TOLERANCE accounting and CONTEXT_INCOMPLETE workload context, computes approximately 0.11574074% channel coverage and makes no provider-cause or email claim.
